question: Does hierarchical compatibility on Dynamic Need plus balanced Broker profiles outperform their marginal model and the old E007 flat compatibility?
hypothesis: The stronger branch will improve top-decile lift and/or AP while exposing better supported local routing pockets.
primary_change: add hierarchical interactions over Dynamic Need, Physical/Location and balanced Broker Supply/Service
secondary_changes: benchmark against old E007 on the same future test
